features: By using your Mozilla account, you can now sync your Spaces, Folders, Tabs, and much more between devices!
The chrome UI now has a better look and feel, implementing squircles and other design elements to make it more visually appealing.
A new on-boarding experience has been added to help new users get started with the browser and its features.
Creating a new Space is now faster and requires less animation wait time, making the process more efficient.
changed: Font size has been increased for the sidebar text, making it easier to read and navigate through tabs and spaces.
